29140-the-mathematicians.title: The Mathematicians
29140-the-mathematicians.creator: Unknown
29140-the-mathematicians.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "Exactly three million and forty-one male adults and three female adults. These creatures first appeared on Earth on the island of Sardinia. In five weeks' time they were the masters of the entire globe."

arxiv-1806-06743.title: Opacity Effects on Pulsations of Main-Sequence A-Type Stars
arxiv-1806-06743.creator: Joyce A. Guzik, Christopher J. Fontes, Chris Fryer
arxiv-1806-06743.description: Abstract Opacity enhancements for stellar interior conditions have been explored to explain observed pulsation frequencies and to extend the pulsation instability region for B-type main-sequence variable stars ( Walczak et al. 2015 ; Walczak et al. 2017 ; Daszyńska-Daszkiewicz et al. 2017 ; Moravveji 2016 ; Cugier 2014 ; Zdravkov and Pamyatnykh 2009 , see, e.g.,) .

arxiv-2110-04182.title: Temporal Convolutions for Multi-Step Quadrotor Motion Prediction Thanks: Institute for Aerospace Studies, University of Toronto, Canada, stevenw@utias.utoronto.ca
arxiv-2110-04182.creator: Samuel Looper, Steven L. Waslander
arxiv-2110-04182.description: Abstract Model-based control methods for robotic systems such as quadrotors, autonomous driving vehicles and flexible manipulators require motion models that generate accurate predictions of complex nonlinear system dynamics over long periods of time. Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCNs) can be adapted to this challenge by formulating multi-step prediction as a sequence-to-sequence modeling problem.

arxiv-2201-12786.title: Similarity Search on Computational Notebooks
arxiv-2201-12786.creator: Misato Horiuchi, Yuya Sasaki, Chuan Xiao, Makoto Onizuka
arxiv-2201-12786.description: Abstract Computational notebook software such as Jupyter Notebook is popular for data science tasks. Numerous computational notebooks are available on the Web and reusable; however, searching for computational notebooks manually is a tedious task, and so far, there are no tools to search for computational notebooks effectively and efficiently.

arxiv-2205-10955.title: Investigating classification learning curves for automatically generated and labelled plant images
arxiv-2205-10955.creator: Michael A. Beck 1 , Christopher P. Bidinosti, Christopher J. Henry, Manisha Ajmani
arxiv-2205-10955.description: Abstract In the context of supervised machine learning a learning curve describes how a model’s performance on unseen data relates to the number of samples used to train the model. In this paper we present a dataset of plant images with representatives of crops and weeds common to the Manitoba prairies at different growth stages.

arxiv-2208-06687.title: Avoider-Enforcer Game is NP-hard
arxiv-2208-06687.creator: Tillmann Miltzow, Miloš Stojaković
arxiv-2208-06687.description: Abstract In an Avoider-Enforcer game, we are given a hypergraph. Avoider and Enforcer alternate in claiming an unclaimed vertex, until all the vertices of the hypergraph are claimed. Enforcer wins if Avoider claims all vertices of an edge; Avoider wins otherwise. We show that it is NP-hard to decide if Avoider has a winning strategy. 1 Introduction Motivation.

arxiv-2301-12372.title: Delay-Adaptive Boundary Control of Coupled Hyperbolic PDE-ODE Cascade Systems
arxiv-2301-12372.creator: Ji Wang, Mamadou Diagne
arxiv-2301-12372.description: Abstract This paper presents a delay-adaptive boundary control scheme for a 2 × 2 2\times 2 coupled linear hyperbolic PDE-ODE cascade system with an unknown and arbitrarily long input delay. To construct a nominal delay-compensated control law, assuming a known input delay, a three-step backstepping design is used.

arxiv-2312-09633.title: Natural Gradient Variational Bayes without Fisher Matrix Analytic Calculation and Its Inversion
arxiv-2312-09633.creator: A. Godichon-Baggioni
arxiv-2312-09633.description: Abstract This paper introduces a method for efficiently approximating the inverse of the Fisher information matrix, a crucial step in achieving effective variational Bayes inference. A notable aspect of our approach is the avoidance of analytically computing the Fisher information matrix and its explicit inversion.

arxiv-2404-02313.title: Optimal combination of composite likelihoods using approximate Bayesian computation with application to state-space models
arxiv-2404-02313.creator: Wentao Li, Rosabeth White, Dennis Prangle
arxiv-2404-02313.description: Abstract Composite likelihood methods can provide approximate inference when the full likelihood is intractable but marginal likelihood functions for small subsets of the data can be evaluated relatively easily. Composite likelihoods have been successfully applied in complex models such as max-stable models and state-space models. However, wider application is limited by two issues.

arxiv-2406-07402.title: A Survey on the Recent Random Walk-based Methods for Embedding Knowledge Graphs
arxiv-2406-07402.creator: Elika Bozorgi, Sakher Khalil Alqaiidi, Afsaneh Shams, Hamid Reza Arabnia, Krzysztof Kochut
arxiv-2406-07402.description: Abstract Machine learning, deep learning, and NLP methods on knowledge graphs are present in different fields and have important roles in various domains from self-driving cars to friend recommendations on social media platforms. However, to apply these methods to knowledge graphs, the data usually needs to be in an acceptable size and format.

europmc-pmc2855614.title: Beneficial effects of green tea: a literature review.
europmc-pmc2855614.creator: Chacko SM, Thambi PT, Kuttan R, Nishigaki I.
europmc-pmc2855614.description: The health benefits of green tea for a wide variety of ailments, including different types of cancer, heart disease, and liver disease, were reported. Many of these beneficial effects of green tea are related to its catechin, particularly (-)-epigallocatechin-3-gallate, content.

Esta revisão de literatura teve como objetivo sintetizar as...

pmc-10547821.title: Clinical Manifestations, Genetic Variants and Therapeutic Evaluation in Sporadic Chinese Patients with Idiopathic Hypogonadotropic Hypogonadism
pmc-10547821.creator: Dongye He, Hailing Sun, Mei Zhang, Yanying Li, Fupeng Liu, Yanhong Zhang, Mingming He, Bo Ban
pmc-10547821.description: PurposeGenetic factors account for a large proportion of idiopathic hypogonadotropic hypogonadism (IHH) etiologies, although not necessarily a complete genetic basis. This study aimed to characterize the clinical presentations, genetic variants, and therapeutic outcomes of patients with sporadic IHH, which may be helpful for genetic counseling and treatment decisions.Patients and MethodsEleven Chinese patients with IHH were retrospectively analyzed.

pmc-10808539.title: Comparative price analysis of biological medicines: disparities generated by different pricing policies
pmc-10808539.creator: Marcela Amaral Pontes, Alane Andrelino Ribeiro, Flávia Caixeta Albuquerque, Silvana Nair Leite Cotenzini
pmc-10808539.description: Introduction: Biological medicines have been assuming an important role among the therapeutic options for several diseases, however, due to their complex production process, the products obtained from this technology have a high added value and do not reach the purchasing power of most patients, which overwhelms the budget of health systems.

pmc-11427890.title: Revisiting oxidation and reduction reactions for synthesizing a three-dimensional hydrogel of reduced graphene oxide†
pmc-11427890.creator: Hon Nhien Le, Thi Bang Tam Dao, Trung Do Nguyen, Duc Anh Dinh, Chi Nhan Ha Thuc, Van Hieu Le
pmc-11427890.description: An improvement to Hummers' method involving a cascade-design graphite oxidation reaction is reported to optimize safety and efficiency in the production of graphite oxide (GrO) and graphene oxide (GO). Chemical reduction using highly alkaline ammonia solution is a novel approach to synthesizing reduced graphene oxide (RGO).

pmc-11437550.title: Multiple Sclerosis and COVID-19: An Overview on Risk, Severity, and Association With Disease Modifying Therapies
pmc-11437550.creator: Mary Hollist, Abraham Hollist, Katherine Au, Colton Betts, Maha Kirmani, Maaida Kirmani, Benjamin Armour, Mercy C Udeh, Batool F Kirmani
pmc-11437550.description: Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), a novel coronavirus, emerged in December 2019, sparking a global health crisis. While initially recognized as a respiratory illness, it has become evident that Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) also affects the central nervous system.

pmc-12440832.title: Effects of Web-Based Symptom Monitoring Program on Symptom Interference, Physical Activity, and Emergency Department Readmissions in Patients With Pre-Capillary Pulmonary Hypertension: Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-12440832.creator: Miao-Yi Chen, Chun-Hsien Wu, Shu-Meng Cheng, Ting-Yu Chen, Chieh-Yu Liu, Yun-Ju Wang, Chi-Wen Kao, Jen-Jiuan Liaw
pmc-12440832.description: BackgroundPre-capillary pulmonary hypertension (PH) is a progressive and incurable disease characterized by high morbidity, frequent emergency department (ED) visits, and persistently poor survival despite targeted therapies. Web-based symptom monitoring programs offer a promising, non-invasive approach to support self-management and enable the early detection of decompensation.

pmc-12709517.title: From epidemiology to precision prevention: Why the latest breast cancer roadmap deserves your attention
pmc-12709517.creator: Ralf Weiskirchen
pmc-12709517.description: exposures into a unified framework, the review offers clinicians and researchers an actionable blueprint for personalized prevention and early detection. The commentary emphasizes the clinical significance, methodological robustness, and public health implications of this article, arguing that it is a must read for anyone engaged in the multidisciplinary management of breast cancer.

pmc-12757684.title: Serial patent litigation: an emerging strategy to delay entry of generic competition
pmc-12757684.creator: Timothy Bonis, Aaron S Kesselheim, Sean Tu
pmc-12757684.description: The Hatch–Waxman Act of 1984 was designed to accelerate generic drug entry by establishing a framework for resolving patent disputes between brand-name and generic manufacturers. While the Act has facilitated competition and expanded the availability of affordable medicines, brand-name firms have increasingly exploited its procedural structure to delay or deter generic competition through “serial litigation.

pmc-12765708.title: Characteristic Gut Microbiota in PCOS-IR Patients and Its Association with Endocrine Features
pmc-12765708.creator: Wenyi Liang, Yanning Yao, Xinyang Ren, Anran Xue, Mengcheng Cai, Jin Yu, Chaoqin Yu, Ling Zhou, DongXia Zhai
pmc-12765708.description: PurposeThe aim of this study is to explore the changes of gut microbiota, the metabolic characteristics and sex hormones in polycystic ovary syndrome with insulin resistance (PCOS-IR), and to clarify the role of gut microbiota in the occurrence of this condition.

pmc-12816105.title: Cross-spatial scale processing of hierarchical auditory sequences in human brains revealed using 7 T magnetic resonance imaging
pmc-12816105.creator: Yangjiayi Mu, Qingyang Liu, Yinghua Chu, Zhao Xu, Weiyang Ding, He Wang, Yuwei Jiang
pmc-12816105.description: Human auditory cognition involves multiregional hierarchical processing, yet the neural mechanisms integrating cortical layers and large-scale networks remain unclear. Using high-resolution fMRI, we investigate cross-spatial scale dynamics during hierarchical auditory processing. Distinct activations across layers of superior temporal gyrus (STG) and inferior frontal gyrus (IFG) are detected during standard stimuli and violation.

pmc-13333661.title: Transversal Double‐Level Mandibular Distraction by Basal Bone Hinge Anchorage and Dentoalveolar Acrylic Plate for a Curved Distraction: Evolution of the Technique in a Double‐Jaw Distraction Case Report
pmc-13333661.creator: Antonio Cortese, Francesca Spirito, Pier Paolo Claudio, Lorenzo Lo Muzio, Osvaldo Basilone, Franco Carlino, Hannah Wesley
pmc-13333661.description: Transverse mandibular deficit is characterized by dental crowding, retroalveolism, and vertical dystopia of the anterior alveolar process. Traditional treatments can cause periodontal, occlusion, and esthetic complications. Distraction osteogenesis represents a technique for enlarging bone segments and promoting the formation of regenerated bone that, after maturation, may show characteristics comparable to native bone, as reported in the literature.
